children: NIKE, Inc. Class B (NYSE:NKE) posted weaker FY26 results and shrinking direct and China sales, prompting cost cuts, analyst price‑target downgrades and a Neutral rating, while shares trade well below key moving averages ahead of its Oct. 1 fiscal Q1 2027 report; Alexandre Arnault joins the board.
Previous Week Recap
NKE Fiscal 2026 Revenue Down
: NKE fiscal 2026 revenue $46.4B, down 2% CC; Q4 revenue $10.97B, down 1%. Direct sales -7%, digital -12%. Greater China double-digit drop; North America slight growth. Operating costs cut.
NIKE, Inc. Class B Removal
: NIKE Class B (NKE) will be removed from the S&P 100 before trading Sept 21 after an 80% five‑year market cap drop. Shares near $36, ~0.4% Dow weight, ~4.6% yield.
Analysts Cut NIKE Price Targets
: Analysts cut NIKE (NKE) price targets this week: Telsey $44, Citi $39, UBS $42 (notes weaker global sales, ~-$0.05 Q1 EPS, Q2 EPS $0.31–$0.43), Baird $44, Morgan Stanley $31
Nike Faces China Competition
: NIKE (NKE) faces tougher competition in China as consumers shift toward local brands; competing with stronger domestic players and global rivals Adidas and Puma, per Citi's Global Athletic Survey
NIKE Q1 2027 Report Date
: NIKE (NKE) will report fiscal Q1 2027 results Oct. 1. Analysts expect about $11.35B revenue and roughly $0.45 EPS. Key event for traders tracking quarterly performance.
NKE Downgraded To Neutral
: NIKE (NKE) downgraded to Neutral by Baird due to oil, rising rates and consumer pressure; NKE shares rose ~1.0% intraday.
NKE Below Key Moving Averages
: NKE trades under key MAs: ~6.3% below 20-day, ~11.3% below 50-day (~resistance ~$41.50), ~14.4% below 100-day, ~28.5% below 200-day; MACD bearish.
Nike-Lululemon Patent Case Ended
: Nike (NKE) and Lululemon dropped their Manhattan patent-infringement suit over Lululemon’s Mirror home workout system with prejudice, formally ending the case; Nike declined to comment.
NIKE, Inc. Class B Board Appointment
: NIKE, Inc. Class B (NKE) announced the appointment of Alexandre Arnault to its board of directors, effective September 15, 2026, increasing the total number of directors on the board to twelve.
